title: Home Oxygen Therapy Claims Posting — Contents Months Paid in Full After the Payment Cap
content:
# Posting a Contents Month Paid in Full — Home Oxygen Therapy

## Situation the rule governs

A Home Oxygen Therapy contents month after the payment cap that the coverage paid in full, leaving no patient share because the plan's out-of-pocket maximum was already met, is posted to the oxygen claim history with its contents allowance. The payer's allowed amount is recorded as both the allowed and the paid amount, and the patient share as 0.00.

For a contents month this rule governs, and only for such a month, the contents allowance is the one this rule fixes; every other contents month remains under the contents billing rule of Home Oxygen Therapy.

## The tool: `record_oxygen_contents_payment_7caaff46`

**Capability.** Posts a monthly oxygen contents claim (gas or liquid supplied after the equipment-payment cap) that the patient's coverage paid in full, leaving nothing for the patient to pay. One call adds one paid contents-month line to the patient's oxygen claim history; the oxygen claim lookup then shows the new paid contents line with the values given.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_oxygen_contents_payment_7caaff46` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `oxygen_holding_id` | reference number of the patient's home oxygen record, from the oxygen record lookup | identifier |
| `coverage_id` | reference number of the coverage record that paid the month, from the coverage lookup | identifier |
| `service_from_date` | first day of the contents month paid | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `adjudication_date` | date of the payer's remittance that paid the month | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `claim_number` | the payer's claim control number for the month, exactly as read from the payer's statement | verbatim, character for character |
| `hcpcs_code` | the code of the contents billed | `E0442` when the contents are liquid oxygen for a liquid system; `E0443` when the contents are gaseous oxygen in portable cylinders; `E1390` is a concentrator equipment month and `E0439` a liquid reservoir equipment month, which this tool never posts |
| `rental_month_number` | ordinal of the contents month counted from the payment cap | non-negative integer, 1 for the first contents month after the cap |
| `allowed_amount` | the payer's allowed amount for the contents month | USD, 2 decimal places; stored as given, also as the amount paid |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation "Posted paid-in-full contents month <`rental_month_number`> (<`service_from_date`>) on oxygen record <`oxygen_holding_id`>: line <line id>, allowed <`allowed_amount`>, paid <`allowed_amount`>, patient share 0.00.", where the line id is the new claim line reference. Its presence means the paid contents line was added.

## Effect on the records

| Before the call | After the call |
|---|---|
| the contents month not on the oxygen claim history | a paid contents line for the month, with the coverage, first day, remittance date, claim number, code and allowed amount given, and patient share 0.00 |

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `rental_month_number` 3, `service_from_date` 2025-10-14 and `allowed_amount` 75.96 returns "Posted paid-in-full contents month 3 (2025-10-14) on oxygen record ...: line ..., allowed 75.96, paid 75.96, patient share 0.00."
